## BUNNY 双阶段 LoRA / Two-Stage LoRAs

**可调 / Adjust:** 四个 LoRA 的文件和权重，可按题材自行替换。/ You may replace the four LoRA files and tune weights for your subject.

一采负责动作、构图、交互；二采负责放大后的结构和细节。若二采改变动作逻辑，先降二采 Motion，再降二采 Weapon。/ Stage 1 controls motion/composition/interaction; Stage 2 reconstructs enlarged structure/detail. If Stage 2 alters motion logic, lower Stage-2 Motion first, then Stage-2 Weapon.

**不要动 / Do not:** 不要把二采 LoRA 直接接回一采链，也不要关闭二采。/ Do not feed Stage-2 LoRAs back into Stage 1, and never bypass Stage 2.

subject_definitions:
Reference A: a female dark-cultivator, early twenties, the exact character shown in the reference image. Blue long twin-tails tied with black ribbons, golden pupils, porcelain skin, a calm, aloof expression. She wears a black gilded Taoist robe with golden cloud motifs, bagua symbols, and traditional Chinese esoteric runes, with elegant golden trim along the collar and cuffs. She is barefoot. She sits on an irregular, naturally formed frost throne of jagged translucent ancient ice crystals, legs crossed, her left elbow resting on the throne's armrest and her left hand propping up her head in a relaxed, languid pose. She is the woman in Reference A; reproduce her face, hairstyle, and robe exactly as depicted, changing nothing. Her right hand is free, held ready to snap her fingers.

Reference B: the final-frame spell image. It shows the terminal state of the water-element technique: its exact color palette, energy form, composition, scale, and lighting are defined by the reference image. Reference B is the visual target of the video's last frame. Throughout the whole piece, the serpentine torrents' material look — the semi-transparent liquid-glass quality, the azure-and-ink-black color scheme, the mercury-like reflections — must follow the style shown in Reference B.

Reference C: the color and atmosphere reference. Cool deep blue, silver-azure, and bright sea-foam white, with towering mountain ranges rising through swirling blue-white cloud seas. Use this image only for palette and mood; it does not define characters, spell forms, or scene layout.

summary:
On a windswept rocky plateau ringed by towering mountain ranges in cool blue-white cloud seas, a female dark-cultivator from Reference A sits on an irregular frost throne, her left elbow on the armrest and her left hand propping up her head. Her body stays almost entirely still — no large movements, no shifting of her pose. Only her right hand moves: she raises it slightly and snaps her fingers once. In the same unbroken shot, the black-gold demonic vortex swelling behind her violently erupts into several colossal headless serpentine torrents of translucent azure-and-black water energy that surge toward the camera in one unified direction. A hard cut opens the second shot: the camera races backward along the ground as the torrents pour head-on toward it, until they decelerate and converge into the exact spell terminal state shown in Reference B on the final frame. Palette and atmosphere follow Reference C.

retention_analysis:
Across all segments, keep Reference A's identity locked: her blue twin-tails with black ribbons, golden pupils, porcelain face, the black gilded Taoist robe with golden cloud motifs and bagua symbols, and her bare feet. Her pose stays locked: left elbow on the armrest, left hand propping up her head, the rest of her body almost entirely still, with only her right hand moving to snap her fingers. Preserve the cinematic UE5 photorealistic xianxia style, the cool palette of Reference C (deep blue, silver-azure, sea-foam white) layered with cold black, deep bronze-gold, and azure energy, and the moody cool-white key light from upper-left. The water energy must stay liquid and viscous, reflective like mercury mixed with ink. The torrents must move as headless, tailless winding currents of water that slither against the ground in a serpentine, snaking motion. From the moment they form, every torrent must pour in a single direction. The irregular frost throne of jagged translucent ice crystals stays beneath her, unchanged.
